admissions at U.G. and P.G. level are done on merit basis, i.e., on the basis of marks obtained in the previous/ qualifying examination. Admission Rules: The prospectus & the application form, and other documents will be available over the college counter in the months of June/July. Candidates seeking admission to UG courses are required to submit their application forms along with all necessary documents to the respective admission committees. Admission to UG and PG first year classes will be granted to only those candidates who have passed their respective qualifying examinations in the immediately preceding academic session. Admission will be granted only on the recommendation of the admission committee. Change of stream is not permissible to candidates from the Arts stream. Candidates from the Commerce stream can apply for any of the courses/subjects to conditions laid down by the university. Seats for all the courses are limited. No admission can be possible after the seats are full. No admission is permissible after the last date as determined by the college/university. All candidates seeking admission to various classes are required to submit the following documents along with the duly filled in application form: Self-attested copies of mark sheets of all qualifying exams. Copy of certificate in proof of age (self-attested copy of High school certificate). Character certificate in original issued by the head of the institution last attended. Four passport size photographs. Incomplete or incorrect applications are liable to be rejected. Change of subject and faculty after admission shall not be allowed to any candidate. It was established on 23 August, 1977, as a result of sincere constant efforts made by Hon’ble Mr. J. B. Saxena, the Sr. General Manager of OFC and all others involved in the pious mission. Since then it has been a prestigious and reputed centre of learning and research, earning great reputation in all spheres of academics. It holds a reputed position among the colleges affiliated to the CSJM University Kanpur. It has now grown into a full- fledged P.G. College of Eminence. The college provides a stimulating environment for intellectual development, free-thinking, and personal growth. The academic environment and set up motivates its students with dynamic learning opportunities. G. College (Affiliated to C.S.J.M. University, Kanpur) is a premier institute situated in Armapore Estate, Kanpur Nagar. It was established on 23 August, 1977, as a result of sincere constant efforts made by Hon’ble Mr. J. B. Saxena, the Sr. General Manager of OFC and all others involved in the pious mission. Since then it has been a prestigious and reputed centre of learning and research, earning great reputation in all spheres of academics. It holds a reputed position among the colleges affiliated to the CSJM University Kanpur. It has now grown into a full- fledged P.G. College of Eminence. The college provides a stimulating environment for intellectual development, free-thinking, and personal growth. The academic environment and set up motivates its students with dynamic learning opportunities. The exceptionally talented and seasoned teaching fraternity motivates the students to push boundaries and become the best versions of themselves. Armapore PG College provides liberal education in disciplines of languages, humanities, social sciences, fine arts and commerce. Currently it has more than 2500 students in various disciplines of U.G, P.G, and Research courses. All courses are currently running as per the norms and standards of N.E.P 2020. The teachers, renowned for meritorious profile and versatile talent, help the students develop a sense of social duty and responsibility. Their sense of communication and problem solving skills make them able to apply their intellectual energy and practical knowledge to diverse fields. Armapore PG College has always sought to maintain high academic standards leading to intellectual and research innovations. The college has been providing its students a creative environment to develop and express sensibilities that are helpful in society and world. Holistic development of a person is incomplete without physical activities and exercises. Keeping this in mind, the college provides training of various steps of Yoda to its students. Apart from this, various units as NCC Air Wing, NCC Army Wing, NSS, Ranger, Rover etc run here efficiently. Apart from academic and physical activities, the college regularly organizes cultural activities and programmes to enhance the sense of diverse cultural values, ethics, morals and meanings of various fine arts. To achieve excellence in Professional Education and create an Ecosystem for the holistic development of students and to reach standards of academic excellence by providing quality education, ethics, values, morality and enhancing employability skills of the students. Mission The mission of Armapore P.G. College is to empower individuals to achieve their educational, professional and personal goals. To educate young students within a framework of liberal and democratic values that instill highest quality education, sense of fine arts, humanistic approach, value added education through distinctive academic programs helping the students to apply their knowledge in the society. Objectives 1 To impart quality education in higher classes to the children of factory employees (O.F.C., S.A.F. & F.G.K.) and nearby rural and urban people. 2 To encourage and inspire those students who are not resourceful but they are intelligent, talented and have desire to achieve higher education through harmonious development of character and self-dependence in becoming a good citizen. 3 To familiarize students about the progress of the scientific knowledge at the national and international level through the three basic aspects (teaching, learning and evolution) of education. 4 To develop the views and to aware the students through audio-visual aids, seminars, conferences, group discussions and interaction with other agencies regarding the social issues and social evils like Environmental pollution, Aids, Population growth etc. 5 To prepare for vocational education in various fields (arts & commerce). 6 To organise sports, N.C.C., N.S.S. & cultural activities among students for the growth of their sports spirit based on moral values.
